# Exact source boxes and an elementary global orbit count

**Full Collatz remains open.** This checkpoint stepped back across the repository, pursued three parallel closing attacks, and developed a fourth elementary counting argument. It adds 19 finite Lean statements, a complete-carry/source decomposition of the actual collision problem, an elementary reconstruction of a stronger orbit-count input, and precise records of the unsuccessful triadic and cycle closing steps.

**Published commit:** `a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371`  
**Tree:** `d23ad9ded19259214cfe6f4b437d9bbe3161df6e`  
**Single parent:** `b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590`

[Start here](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/README.md) · [Repository reassessment](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/REPO_REASSESSMENT.md) · [Exact source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/SOURCES.json) · [Verification and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/README.md)

## Why this change

The preceding common pressure maximum, full numerical cancellation identities and original-source pressure accounting sharpened the remaining targets without closing them. This round connects those results to the newer triadic certificates, actual-boundary dimension work and critical collision lower bound. The metadata inventory covers all 145 PR records at the inspection snapshot: 122 open and 23 closed. Selected current and older source files were read in detail; this is not a claim to have reverified every proof on every branch.

## 1. Exact source boxes remove within-box residue collisions

For one literal odd window with odd depth `m`, total binary clock `A`, original source `p`, endpoint `q`, and complete ordered carry `C`, retain

`2^A q = 3^m p + C`.

Fix the three integers

`(A, floor(C/3^m), floor(p/2^A))`.

Within that box, `q mod 3^m` determines the complete word, the original source and the endpoint. On one injective ordinary orbit it also determines the occurrence index. Absolute source height can be arbitrarily large.

The proof decodes the word from its complete length, odd count and carry. Endpoint residue plus carry quotient determines the carry; the affine identity gives the source residue modulo `2^A`; the source quotient determines the source itself. None of the affine terms is dropped.

For the original nonnegative occurrence weights, collision energy inside one box equals its ordinary diagonal. A carry-quotient interval of width `R` gives the exact repeated-word bound

`Col <= R * sum_w (sum_{j:W_j=w} t_j)^2`.

The full application to the moving inverse law keeps every cross-box term and pays all omitted mass. Those cross-box contributions remain uncontrolled. The result is a finite injection and decomposition, not a global mixing estimate.

[Full derivation and actual-law consumer](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/ACTUAL_COLLISION.md) · [CarryFibers.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/CarryFibers.lean)

**Formal boundary:** sixteen finite statements. Exact physical identities are explicit hypotheses of the endpoint consumers. The infinite harmonic-flow construction and the critical lower bound are pinned written inputs, not new formalized conclusions.

### The atomic diagonal fixes the admissible precision budget

With `N=M+1` retained roots, the ordinary diagonal is bounded below by `c_0^2/N`. Therefore a full upper bound

`Col = o(sqrt(m) * 3^(-theta*m))`

requires

`N * sqrt(m) / 3^(theta*m) -> infinity`,

where `theta=H_2(log_3 2)=0.949955527188...`. The lower-bound condition `m^2=O(M)` alone does not supply this. In particular `m` comparable to `sqrt(M)` cannot support that full upper. Logarithmic precision with sufficiently large windows remains compatible. Additional trimming must pay its own omitted mass; rate-free remainder convergence cannot silently pay an exponential precision requirement.

## 2. Elementary reconstruction of a global separated-visit bound

For every forward-invariant set `S` of positive odd integers on which the accelerated odd map is injective, the written proof gives the uniform bound

`#(S intersect [1,X]) = O(X^theta / sqrt(1+log X))`.

This includes a whole injective odd orbit, a cycle, or the set of positive odd periodic states. It does not assume injectivity on a branching predecessor basin. Finite truncated trajectories require an explicit terminal allowance.

At one fixed odd depth near `log_3(X/8)`, sources with large total binary clock map injectively into the same set below `X/2`. Small-clock words occupy a binomially bounded collection of complete source residue classes. The exact negative-binomial identity and an iterated height reduction give the estimate even when intermediate orbit values exceed `X`.

This strengthens the `4X^(39/40)` input previously used on this branch. It yields distinct-state moments for `s>theta` and improves the correction-product estimate at a large component floor. It does not establish the critical moment, remove an escaping pressure atom or prove convergence.

**Literature scope:** this is an elementary reconstruction, not a record claim. [Lyapunov Weaver, rStation Paper 28 v3](https://rstation.ai/problems/collatz/papers/28) already states stronger full-orbit estimates, including a stronger logarithmic factor and a further power gain. The earlier discussion also contains the critical exponent with the square-root logarithmic denominator. Those primary statements are credited; the stronger external analytic chain is not imported as a newly audited theorem.

[Written proof and consequences](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/GLOBAL_ORBIT_COUNT.md) · [OrbitCounting.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/OrbitCounting.lean)

**Formal boundary:** three finite statements establish the carry bound, high-clock height compression and injective cardinal charge. The residue-cylinder count, binomial asymptotics, infinite recursion and integral consequences remain written proofs with independent reviews.

## 3. Direct closing attacks and their first unresolved steps

### Triadic certificate construction

The preceding pressure maximum forces every complementary real prefix to contract differences by less than `(3/4)^K`. At a fixed initial triadic denominator, legal numerators still occupy one translated progression modulo `2^K`. Real contraction does not control that translation.

Respecting a candidate's own height bound permits only `O(sqrt K)` denominator exponents. The obvious pigeonhole argument produces a difference with an extra odd factor `3^d-1`, usually outside the permitted denominator class, and its guarantee does not give the needed numerator-height saving. A certificate-capacity calculation limits this conservative criterion without claiming a stopping-time lower bound or an escaping source. A later band offset also still needs both the original-source floor comparison and its actual prefix clock.

[TRIADIC_CLOSURE.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/TRIADIC_CLOSURE.md)

### Complete numerical cycle cancellation

Splitting the full chronological carry while retaining `D=2^A-3^p` gives a partial matching between short enough block-word families. Conditioning on the complete zero-residue equation destroys the independence needed to iterate the small-atom estimate. A four-pair control from repetitions of the known cycle exhibits this dependence exactly.

The resulting matching estimate is weaker than the existing polynomial zero-fibre census and does not exclude unrestricted positive cycles. No additional Lean wrappers assert that the unsupported estimates hold.

[COMPLETE_CYCLE.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/COMPLETE_CYCLE.md)

## Verification actually executed

| Check | Observed result and scope |
|---|---|
| Fresh Lean compilation | Unchanged carry dependency, both new modules, and audit all exited zero with warnings as errors |
| New public statements | 16 carry/source-fibre statements plus 3 finite counting statements; all 19 axiom-audited |
| Axioms | Only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; no admitted proof or custom Collatz axiom |
| Exact Python replay | Normal and `-O` runs passed with byte-identical output |
| Carry and ordinary-window controls | 8,191 complete words; 25,265 translated carry fibres; 7,598 actual overlapping windows; 7,217 exact source boxes |
| Counting controls | 3,160 exact negative-binomial identities; 1,182 high-clock source checks; complete low-lane and separated-visit checks |
| Invalid simplifications | Controls detect omitted carry/source quotients, deleted repeated words, dropped cross-box terms, invalid whole-basin injectivity and false conditional independence |
| Review | Separate reconstructions of the finite carry results, global count, triadic boundary and cycle boundary; reviewed hashes retained |

The finite test weights are explicitly supplied test weights, not samples from a hypothetical canonical escaping law.

[Lean receipt and axiom output](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/LEAN_RECEIPT.json) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/EXACT_RECEIPT.json) · [Source binding](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/SOURCE_BINDING.json) · [Principal review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/ROOT_REVIEW.md)

### Exact published-commit checkout

After publication, fetched the remote branch and created a fresh detached complete checkout at `a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371`. Ran `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py`, writing its receipt outside that checkout. All five required commands exited zero:

1. `tools/check_integration_state.py`
2. `tools/check_review_integration.py`
3. `tools/check_review_integration.py --self-test`
4. `tools/test_integrity_portability.py`
5. `reports/prepublic-2026-09-05/integration-d/check_followup.py --self-test`

Observed **489 tracked files**, the exact tree above, and a clean checkout after execution. All **24** source/report bindings matched. All **37** older tracked Lean files were byte-identical to the preceding checkpoint. All **4** freshly compiled inputs matched the published bytes. Remote branch, PR head, tree and single parent were read back after pushing.

The in-repository `CHECKOUT_VALIDATION.json` records the earlier clean local science checkpoint before the two receipt files were added; the published-head run above includes those files. Repository integrity checks are separate from mathematical verification.

## Continuity and remaining mathematical target

All 26 new files are additive. The [previous closure checkpoint](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/closure-round2-20261123/README.md) and [earlier high-variance work](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/research/high-variance-20261123/README.md) remain intact. The preceding PR description is archived in [PR182_BEFORE.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371/reports/2026-11-23-whole-repo-round3/PR182_BEFORE.json).

The central collision target is now to control mass and residue alignment across the different boxes actually occupied by one unchanged orbit, at a precision compatible with its atomic diagonal. Constructing the qualifying triadic certificate and excluding complete-denominator zero residues remain alternative closing routes. None has been asserted as a theorem here. The PR remains an open draft on its existing base.
